common.sampleBannerBody: Using the built-in offline Indian Railways reference timetable. Always verify live running status on NTES / RailOne / IRCTC before travel.

detail.title: Connection details
detail.notFound: Connection details are no longer in memory. Please run the search again.
detail.ratingRuleNote: Based on scheduled arrival/departure and estimated transfer time. Not a guarantee or probability.
detail.sameStationDetail: No station change required. Both trains use {{station}} ({{code}}).
detail.stationChangeDetail: You must change stations from {{fromName}} ({{fromCode}}) to {{toName}} ({{toCode}}).
detail.transferUnknownDetail: No transfer duration is recorded for {{fromCode}} → {{toCode}}. Do not assume this connection is comfortable.
detail.lateNightDetailWarning: Late-night transfer window (23:00–05:00 IST). Local transport and station services may be limited.

settings.title: Settings & Data
settings.bufferProfileHelper: Adds an extra safety margin when rating connection buffers.
settings.apiStatusOnline: Connected to live backend — searches run directly without manual sync.
settings.apiStatusOffline: Backend unreachable — using offline local schedule fallback.
settings.syncHelper: Load a verified ConnectGuard JSON timetable from a URL or paste JSON below. Once imported, the app works fully offline.
settings.aboutBody: Offline-first 1-stop connection planner for Indian Railway passengers travelling on two separate tickets. All ratings are rule-based schedule estimates, never probabilities or live status.
